task: LinkedIn (the person's own account): request LinkedIn's official data archive, which is the only export that still includes Connections, so Connections.csv can seed the BehalfBot CRM. Uses LinkedIn's own 'Get a copy of your data' feature, no scraping

steps.human: Make sure you are signed in to LinkedIn in this tab. Press Done when you see 'Get a copy of your data'.

steps.do: Choose the first option, 'Download larger data archive'. The 'select particular files' list no longer offers Connections, so do not use it. Do not press Request archive.

steps.human: Check that 'Download larger data archive' is selected. Press Request archive yourself (re-enter your password if asked), then Done.

steps.do: Report the status LinkedIn shows. The archive goes to the account email and can take up to 24 hours. Stop there.

accept: LinkedIn shows the archive as requested or ready. When the email arrives the person downloads the zip, unzips it on their own computer and sends ONLY Connections.csv to the bot, never the zip: the archive also holds their messages. The bot runs chassis/scripts/crm_import.py on it, dry run first.
notes: As of 2026-11-20 the 'Want something in particular?' list offers only Articles, Invitations, Profile, Recommendations and Registration; Connections comes only with the larger archive.
Never open messaging, search or other people's profiles: only the settings data-export page.
No scraping and no paging through connections: LinkedIn's own export avoids the anti-automation risk.
The download happens outside the extension; nothing is saved by the driver.
